title: Domain Deal Reality Room
oneLiner: Help a first-time domain seller compare buyer signals, valuation ranges, escrow fees, and three counteroffers without mistaking an AI estimate for cash.
targetUser: Indie hackers and first-time domain sellers negotiating a $1k–$50k inbound offer.
keyUX: Paste the offer, separate evidence from estimates, compare walk-away/target/stretch scenarios, and rehearse counteroffers.
